design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label

pass2.earlyWindow: nonces 1..n, n = the epoch's captured depth
pass2.statistic: per-slot standardised return: Σ (win − p)/√(p(1 − p)) over the scored slots, ÷ √slots; p = winning draws of the played target / 2^32
pass2.units: slotBets[j] / slotWins[j] = slots replaying the epoch's j-th played target and their wins; ret8 = sum of multipliers in 1e-8 units; mean = sum multiplier8 × w (divide by 2^32 for 1e-8 units); var = sum multiplier8² × w × (2^32 − w) (divide by 2^64 for 1e-16 units); w = winning draws of the target
